// why: Separate program for the service worker (#514). src/sw.ts runs in a ServiceWorkerGlobalScope: its `WebWorker` lib and the app's `DOM` lib define the same global names differently, so a single program cannot typecheck both — a `/// <reference lib="webworker" />` inside src/ retypes addEventListener for every file in the project. `npm run typecheck` runs this alongside tsconfig.json so the worker is never left unchecked.
